globals.name: net_tx
globals.title: net_tx
globals.global_formula: $if(tc(json, gv(latest), ".items[0].stats.b[0]") != "", mu(max, 0, tc(json, gv(latest), ".items[0].stats.b[0]")), if(tc(json, gv(latest), ".items[0].stats.ns") != "", mu(max, 0, tc(json, gv(latest), ".items[0].stats.ns")) * 1048576, if(tc(json, gv(sys_json), ".items[" + gv(sys_idx) + "].info.bb[0]") != "", mu(max, 0, tc(json, gv(sys_json), ".items[" + gv(sys_idx) + "].info.bb[0]")), 0)))$

globals.name: rate_tx
globals.title: rate_tx
globals.global_formula: $if(gv(net_tx) >= 1048576, mu(round, gv(net_tx) / 1048576, 1) + " MiB/s", mu(round, gv(net_tx) / 1024, 1) + " KiB/s")$

globals.name: net_rx

globals.name: ram_fmt
